entry: first complete 1m open strictly later than 5m reclaim available_at + 500ms

stop: one tick plus 0.10 break ATR beyond full completed break-to-5m-reclaim excursion
target: nearest still-unconsumed prior-day/prior-week/confirmed width-2 4h external draw in reversal direction, known before entry and payout >24bp
state_exit: first later completed 5m close reaccepted in original break direction, then +500ms
funding: actual signed Bybit funding with one adverse entry-known reserve in planned loss
